By utilizing generous whitespace and a structured information hierarchy, the UI avoids the cluttered \\\"bargain bin\\\" feel of traditional marketplaces, opting instead for a curated, high-end gallery atmosphere.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is anchored by **Deep Teal (#0E7490)**, serving as the primary brand color to evoke stability and professional depth. **Amber (#F59E0B)** is used sparingly as a \\\"Warm Accent\\\" for critical calls-to-action, ratings, and trust badges, providing a high-contrast counterpoint that draws the eye without creating visual fatigue.\\n\\nThe neutral scale is expansive, favoring cool grays to maintain a crisp, clean environment. Surfaces primarily use white (#FFFFFF) with subtle off-white (#F9FAFB) for section differentiation.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system employs a dual-sans approach. **Manrope** is used for headlines to provide a modern, slightly geometric character that feels premium and friendly. **Inter** handles all functional and body text, ensuring maximum legibility across dense product data and mobile screens.\\n\\nType hierarchy is strictly enforced through weight variance rather than just size. Labels and metadata should use `label-sm` with increased letter spacing to maintain a systematic, \\\"data-rich\\\" feel without overwhelming the user.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe system utilizes a **Fluid Grid** with fixed maximum widths for desktop (1280px) to maintain readability. \\n\\n- **Desktop:** 12-column grid, 24px gutters.\\n- **Tablet:** 8-column grid, 20px gutters.\\n- **Mobile:** 4-column grid, 16px margins.\\n\\nSpacing follows a strict 4pt / 8pt rhythmic scale. Use `lg` (48px) spacing between major sections and `sm` (16px) for internal component padding. Group related marketplace items using tight `xs` (8px) spacing to imply a logical connection.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system uses **Tonal Layers** and **Ambient Shadows** to define hierarchy. \\n\\n1.  **Level 0 (Base):** #FFFFFF or #F9FAFB background.\\n2.  **Level 1 (Cards):** #FFFFFF with a 1px border (#E5E7EB). No shadow at rest.\\n3.  **Level 2 (Hover/Active):** A soft, diffused shadow (0px 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)) to indicate interactivity.\\n4.  **Level 3 (Modals/Overlays):** High-diffusion shadow (0px 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)) to separate the action from the background.\\n\\nAvoid heavy black shadows; instead, use a slight primary-tinted shadow (#0E7490 at 5% opacity) for colored elements to maintain a clean, professional aesthetic.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is **Rounded (Level 2)**. This 0.5rem (8px) base radius provides a friendly, approachable feel while remaining professional enough for a high-trust marketplace. \\n\\n- **Cards \\u0026 Modals:** 1rem (16px) for larger containers (`rounded-lg`).\\n- **Inputs \\u0026 Small Buttons:** 0.5rem (8px).\\n- **Badges/Tags:** Fully pill-shaped to contrast against the structured grid of product cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n\\n### Buttons\\n- **Primary:** Filled Teal (#0E7490) with white text. 8px radius. Medium weight text.\\n- **Secondary:** Ghost style with Teal border and text. \\n- **Urgent/Buy:** Filled Amber (#F59E0B) for the \\\"Add to Cart\\\" or \\\"Buy Now\\\" flow to differentiate from navigation actions.\\n\\n### Cards\\nProduct cards are the core of the marketplace. They feature a clean 1px border, 16px padding, and 16px corner radius. Image containers within cards should have a 12px radius to create a nested \\\"soft\\\" look. Metadata (price, location) uses bold `title-lg` styling for immediate scanning.\\n\\n### Input Fields\\nInputs use a 1px #D1D5DB border. On focus, the border transitions to Primary Teal with a 2px outer glow. Labels are always positioned above the field using `label-md` for accessibility.\\n\\n### Trust Signals \\u0026 Badges\\n\\\"Verified\\\" or \\\"Top Seller\\\" badges use the secondary Amber color with a small icon. **Corporate Modernism** blended with **Minimalist** clarity. It targets a discerning audience that values efficiency and security in a peer-to-peer or professional marketplace. The aesthetic is intentionally \\\"quiet\\\" to let product photography and trust signals stand out.\\n\\nThe emotional response should be one of immediate competence and reliability. By utilizing generous whitespace and a structured information hierarchy, the UI avoids the cluttered \\\"bargain bin\\\" feel of traditional marketplaces, opting instead for a curated, high-end gallery atmosphere.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is anchored by **Deep Teal (#0E7490)**, serving as the primary brand color to evoke stability and professional depth. **Amber (#F59E0B)** is used sparingly as a \\\"Warm Accent\\\" for critical calls-to-action, ratings, and trust badges, providing a high-contrast counterpoint that draws the eye without creating visual fatigue.\\n\\nThe neutral scale is expansive, favoring cool grays to maintain a crisp, clean environment. Surfaces primarily use white (#FFFFFF) with subtle off-white (#F9FAFB) for section differentiation.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system employs a dual-sans approach. **Manrope** is used for headlines to provide a modern, slightly geometric character that feels premium and friendly. **Inter** handles all functional and body text, ensuring maximum legibility across dense product data and mobile screens.\\n\\nType hierarchy is strictly enforced through weight variance rather than just size. Labels and metadata should use `label-sm` with increased letter spacing to maintain a systematic, \\\"data-rich\\\" feel without overwhelming the user.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe system utilizes a **Fluid Grid** with fixed maximum widths for desktop (1280px) to maintain readability. \\n\\n- **Desktop:** 12-column grid, 24px gutters.\\n- **Tablet:** 8-column grid, 20px gutters.\\n- **Mobile:** 4-column grid, 16px margins.\\n\\nSpacing follows a strict 4pt / 8pt rhythmic scale. Use `lg` (48px) spacing between major sections and `sm` (16px) for internal component padding. Group related marketplace items using tight `xs` (8px) spacing to imply a logical connection.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system uses **Tonal Layers** and **Ambient Shadows** to define hierarchy. \\n\\n1.  **Level 0 (Base):** #FFFFFF or #F9FAFB background.\\n2.  **Level 1 (Cards):** #FFFFFF with a 1px border (#E5E7EB). No shadow at rest.\\n3.  **Level 2 (Hover/Active):** A soft, diffused shadow (0px 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)) to indicate interactivity.\\n4.  **Level 3 (Modals/Overlays):** High-diffusion shadow (0px 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)) to separate the action from the background.\\n\\nAvoid heavy black shadows; instead, use a slight primary-tinted shadow (#0E7490 at 5% opacity) for colored elements to maintain a clean, professional aesthetic.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is **Rounded (Level 2)**. This 0.5rem (8px) base radius provides a friendly, approachable feel while remaining professional enough for a high-trust marketplace. \\n\\n- **Cards \\u0026 Modals:** 1rem (16px) for larger containers (`rounded-lg`).\\n- **Inputs \\u0026 Small Buttons:** 0.5rem (8px).\\n- **Badges/Tags:** Fully pill-shaped to contrast against the structured grid of product cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n\\n### Buttons\\n- **Primary:** Filled Teal (#0E7490) with white text. 8px radius. Medium weight text.\\n- **Secondary:** Ghost style with Teal border and text. \\n- **Urgent/Buy:** Filled Amber (#F59E0B) for the \\\"Add to Cart\\\" or \\\"Buy Now\\\" flow to differentiate from navigation actions.\\n\\n### Cards\\nProduct cards are the core of the marketplace. They feature a clean 1px border, 16px padding, and 16px corner radius. Image containers within cards should have a 12px radius to create a nested \\\"soft\\\" look. The aesthetic is **Minimalist with Tactile accents**, prioritizing heavy whitespace and cinematic imagery to tell a story of celebration and legacy.\\n\\nThe target audience seeks exclusivity, cultural depth, and meticulous attention to detail. The UI must evoke a sense of \\\"stately warmth\\\"—feeling both prestigious and deeply personal. Visuals should feel \\\"curated\\\" rather than \\\"produced,\\\" using generous breathing room to allow individual elements to hold the viewer's gaze. Subtle cultural cues are integrated through intricate patterns used sparingly as low-opacity backgrounds and precise, gold-toned hairline dividers.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in the \\\"Trimurti\\\" of Indian luxury: Deep Maroon, Aged Gold, and Bone White.\\n\\n- **Primary (Deep Maroon):** Used for key brand moments, call-to-action backgrounds, and high-level headings. It represents the emotional depth and traditional roots of the events.\\n- **Secondary (Aged Gold):** Used for accents, icons, and borders. It should never be used for large blocks of text; it functions as a \\\"metallic\\\" highlight.\\n- **Tertiary (Bone/Off-white):** The primary background color. It provides a softer, more sophisticated canvas than pure white, reducing visual fatigue and adding a parchment-like quality.\\n- **Neutral:** A soft charcoal used for body text to maintain high legibility without the harshness of absolute black.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThe typographic hierarchy relies on the contrast between the historical grace of **EB Garamond** and the modern, geometric precision of **Manrope**.\\n\\n- **Headlines:** Use EB Garamond for all display and headline roles. It conveys authority and literary heritage. For very large display text, use a slightly tighter letter spacing to create a cohesive visual block.\\n- **Body \\u0026 Functional Text:** Manrope provides a clean, neutral balance to the expressive serif. It ensures that logistical information (dates, venues, pricing) remains crystal clear and professional.\\n- **Labels:** Use Manrope in all-caps with generous letter spacing for categories and small identifiers to mimic the look of luxury stationery.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop to maintain a composed, \\\"framed\\\" appearance like a high-end invitation. \\n\\n- **Desktop:** A 12-column grid with wide 32px gutters. Margins are intentionally large (64px) to create a protective \\\"border\\\" around the content, emphasizing the premium nature of the information.\\n- **Mobile:** A 4-column grid with 20px margins. \\n- **Vertical Rhythm:** Use an 8px base unit. Section spacing should be aggressive—utilizing 120px to 160px of vertical space between major content blocks to prevent the UI from feeling \\\"crowded\\\" or utilitarian.\\n- **Imagery:** Photography should often \\\"break\\\" the grid or span full-bleed to create a cinematic, immersive experience.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nDepth is achieved through **Tonal Layering** and **Subtle Ambient Shadows** rather than aggressive stacking.\\n\\n- **Surface Strategy:** Use the Bone White (Tertiary) as the base. Higher elevation levels (like modals or floating cards) should use pure white with a very soft, diffused shadow (Blur: 30px, Opacity: 4%, Color: Primary).\\n- **Dividers:** Instead of shadows, use 0.5px \\\"Gold Hairlines\\\" to separate sections. This creates a structural, architectural feel.\\n- **Depth through Imagery:** Use parallax scrolling on background cinematic images to create a sense of physical space and \\\"peeking\\\" into a grand venue.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is primarily **Soft and Rectilinear**. We avoid fully rounded \\\"pill\\\" shapes as they feel too casual/tech-oriented.\\n\\n- **Elements:** Use a 4px (0.25rem) corner radius for most containers and buttons. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. No border.\\n  - *Secondary:* Transparent background, Deep Burgundy 1px border.\\n  - *Action Label:* \\\"Start planning\\\" is the primary driver.\\n- **Chips:** Fully rounded, using Ivory background and Muted Text for categories, or Gold background with White text for featured highlights.\\n- **Input Fields:** White surface, Soft Border (#E5DED4), 8px radius. Labels in Manrope 12px Bold (Caps).\\n- **Cards:** White background, 14px radius, 1px Soft Border. Shadows are applied only on hover to indicate interactivity.\\n- **Lists:** Use 24px spacing between items with a thin 1px horizontal divider in Soft Border color.\\n- **Navigation:** Clean, high-contrast links in Manrope. embodies a \\\"Modern Indian Premium\\\" aesthetic, balancing the grandeur of Hyderabad’s event culture with contemporary digital clarity. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. design system embodies a \\\"Modern Indian Premium\\\" aesthetic, balancing the grandeur of Hyderabad’s event culture with contemporary digital clarity. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. No border.\\n  - *Secondary:* Transparent background, Deep Burgundy 1px border.\\n  - *Action Label:* \\\"Start planning\\\" is the primary driver.\\n- **Chips:** Fully rounded, using Ivory background and Muted Text for categories, or Gold background with White text for featured highlights.\\n- **Input Fields:** White surface, Soft Border (#E5DED4), 8px radius. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. No border.\\n  - *Secondary:* Transparent background, Deep Burgundy 1px border.\\n  - *Action Label:* \\\"Start planning\\\" is the primary driver.\\n- **Chips:** Fully rounded, using Ivory background and Muted Text for categories, or Gold background with White text for featured highlights.\\n- **Input Fields:** White surface, Soft Border (#E5DED4), 8px radius. Labels in Manrope 12px Bold (Caps).\\n- **Cards:** White background, 14px radius, 1px Soft Border. Shadows are applied only on hover to indicate interactivity.\\n- **Lists:** Use 24px spacing between items with a thin 1px horizontal divider in Soft Border color.\\n- **Navigation:** Clean, high-contrast links in Manrope. design system embodies a \\\"Modern Indian Premium\\\" aesthetic, balancing the grandeur of Hyderabad’s event culture with contemporary digital clarity. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. No border.\\n  - *Secondary:* Transparent background, Deep Burgundy 1px border.\\n  - *Action Label:* \\\"Start planning\\\" is the primary driver.\\n- **Chips:** Fully rounded, using Ivory background and Muted Text for categories, or Gold background with White text for featured highlights.\\n- **Input Fields:** White surface, Soft Border (#E5DED4), 8px radius. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. No border.\\n  - *Secondary:* Transparent background, Deep Burgundy 1px border.\\n  - *Action Label:* \\\"Start planning\\\" is the primary driver.\\n- **Chips:** Fully rounded, using Ivory background and Muted Text for categories, or Gold background with White text for featured highlights.\\n- **Input Fields:** White surface, Soft Border (#E5DED4), 8px radius. Labels in Manrope 12px Bold (Caps).\\n- **Cards:** White background, 14px radius, 1px Soft Border. Shadows are applied only on hover to indicate interactivity.\\n- **Lists:** Use 24px spacing between items with a thin 1px horizontal divider in Soft Border color.\\n- **Navigation:** Clean, high-contrast links in Manrope. The active state is indicated by a small Gold dot or a 2px Burgundy underline, rather than a bold font weight change.\\n- **Photography Containers:** Use \\\"Aspect Ratio\\\" boxes to ensure images of design system embodies a \\\"Modern Indian Premium\\\" aesthetic, balancing the grandeur of Hyderabad’s event culture with contemporary digital clarity. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. No border.\\n  - *Secondary:* Transparent background, Deep Burgundy 1px border.\\n  - *Action Label:* \\\"Start planning\\\" is the primary driver.\\n- **Chips:** Fully rounded, using Ivory background and Muted Text for categories, or Gold background with White text for featured highlights.\\n- **Input Fields:** White surface, Soft Border (#E5DED4), 8px radius. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. design system embodies a \\\"Modern Indian Premium\\\" aesthetic, balancing the grandeur of Hyderabad’s event culture with contemporary digital clarity. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. No border.\\n  - *Secondary:* Transparent background, Deep Burgundy 1px border.\\n  - *Action Label:* \\\"Start planning\\\" is the primary driver.\\n- **Chips:** Fully rounded, using Ivory background and Muted Text for categories, or Gold background with White text for featured highlights.\\n- **Input Fields:** White surface, Soft Border (#E5DED4), 8px radius. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text. embodies a \\\"Modern Indian Premium\\\" aesthetic, balancing the grandeur of Hyderabad’s event culture with contemporary digital clarity. The personality is refined, trustworthy, and celebratory, avoiding excessive ornamentation in favor of high-end editorial composition.\\n\\nThe style is **Modern Corporate with Tactile Elegance**. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. design system embodies a \\\"Modern Indian Premium\\\" aesthetic, balancing the grandeur of Hyderabad’s event culture with contemporary digital clarity. It utilizes a \\\"Warm Ivory Canvas\\\" to move away from cold, generic tech whites, creating an inviting atmosphere that feels like a physical invitation. Movement should be subtle and fluid, echoing the grace of traditional Indian hospitality. The focus is on authentic, high-resolution photography framed by generous whitespace and precise typography.\\n\\n## Colors\\nThe palette is rooted in heritage and luxury. \\n- **Deep Burgundy (#4A0E0E)** serves as the anchor, providing a sense of depth and prestige. \\n- **Premium Gold (#C5A059)** is used as a strategic accent for highlights and primary calls to action, evoking the richness of Indian jewelry and silk. \\n- **Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2)** is the primary background color to maintain a soft, approachable feel.\\n- **Surface White (#FFFFFF)** is reserved for interactive cards and input fields to ensure they \\\"pop\\\" against the ivory backdrop with maximum legibility.\\n- **Ink (#1A1A1A)** is used for primary text to ensure high contrast and readability.\\n\\n## Typography\\nThis design system uses a dual-font strategy. **EB Garamond** is used exclusively for editorial moments, such as hero section titles and major section headers, to instill a sense of timelessness. **Manrope** handles all functional UI tasks—navigation, body text, forms, and data—providing a sharp, modern counterpoint that ensures the platform feels technically sophisticated and easy to use.\\n\\nFor mobile, reduce `display-hero` sizes to avoid awkward line breaks. Always prioritize generous line-height (1.6) for body text to maintain the premium, breathable feel.\\n\\n## Layout \\u0026 Spacing\\nThe layout follows a **Fixed Grid** model on desktop (12 columns, 1280px max-width) and a fluid model on mobile (4 columns). \\n\\nThe spacing philosophy is \\\"Generous \\u0026 Intentional.\\\" Use `lg` (48px) and `xl` (80px) vertical spacing between major sections to emphasize exclusivity. Elements should never feel crowded. \\n- **Margins:** 24px on mobile, 48px+ on desktop.\\n- **Gutters:** 24px fixed to maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.\\n- **Padding:** Content inside white cards should use a minimum of `md` (24px) padding to ensure a luxurious frame around information.\\n\\n## Elevation \\u0026 Depth\\nThe design system avoids heavy shadows. Depth is primarily achieved through **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.\\n\\n- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Warm Ivory (#F9F7F2).\\n- **Level 1 (Cards):** Surface White (#FFFFFF) with a 1px border of Soft Border (#E5DED4).\\n- **Interactive Depth:** Only use a shadow on primary interactive elements (like the \\\"Start planning\\\" button or an active card) using a very soft, diffused burgundy-tinted shadow: `0px 10px 30px rgba(74, 14, 14, 0.05)`.\\n- **Image Treatment:** Photography should have a slight inner glow or a very thin border to feel \\\"set into\\\" the page rather than floating on top.\\n\\n## Shapes\\nThe shape language is sophisticated and soft. \\n- **Standard Cards:** Use a 14px radius to provide a modern, friendly structure.\\n- **Photography:** Large hero images or gallery thumbnails should use a more pronounced 20px radius to soften the visual impact of high-contrast photos.\\n- **Buttons:** Use a smaller 8px radius for a more precise, professional look.\\n- **Chips/Badges:** Must be fully rounded (Pill-shaped) to distinguish them from interactive buttons or cards.\\n\\n## Components\\n- **Buttons:**\\n  - *Primary:* Deep Burgundy background, White text.
